tasks.title: Progress badge should use whole percentages
tasks.problem_statement: The progress badge in consumer_app.progress is misusing providerlib.metrics.clamp_percentage. Fix the badge so it displays whole percentages instead of a fractional percentage string.
tasks.test_context: The failing test checks that progress values render as rounded whole percentages and clamp values above 100.

tasks.title: Retry delay should preserve provider defaults
tasks.problem_statement: consumer_app.retries no longer respects the default semantics of providerlib.http.parse_retry_header for missing or blank headers. Restore the helper contract so missing retry headers still fall back to one second.
tasks.test_context: The failing test covers None, blank, and numeric Retry-After values and expects the helper's one-second default.

tasks.title: Usernames should use provider normalization
tasks.problem_statement: consumer_app.usernames is bypassing providerlib.identity.normalize_username. Fix the consumer so usernames follow providerlib's normalization rules, including whitespace collapsing.
tasks.test_context: The failing test expects leading whitespace removal, internal whitespace collapsing, and lowercase usernames.

tasks.title: Primary email should preserve provider cleaning rules
tasks.problem_statement: consumer_app.emails is no longer delegating to providerlib.identity.choose_primary_email. Fix the consumer so email selection uses providerlib's trimming and lowercase behavior.
tasks.test_context: The failing test checks that the first non-empty email is normalized rather than returned verbatim.

tasks.title: Feature flags should use provider parsing
tasks.problem_statement: consumer_app.flags is treating feature flag strings as generic truthy values instead of using providerlib.http.parse_feature_flag. Fix the consumer so explicit off-like values remain disabled.
tasks.test_context: The failing test distinguishes on/off string values and expects None to stay disabled.

tasks.title: Timeouts should stay in milliseconds
tasks.problem_statement: consumer_app.timeouts is double-converting the output of providerlib.metrics.seconds_to_timeout_ms. Fix the consumer so providerlib's millisecond contract is preserved.
tasks.test_context: The failing test verifies that providerlib already returns milliseconds and that None maps to zero.

tasks.title: Tag order should stay provider-defined
tasks.problem_statement: consumer_app.tags is reordering the output of providerlib.identity.normalize_tags. Fix the consumer so providerlib's normalized tag order is preserved.
tasks.test_context: The failing test expects duplicates to collapse without sorting the provider-defined order.

tasks.title: Ratio fallback should respect caller default
tasks.problem_statement: consumer_app.ratios is no longer preserving the caller's fallback label when providerlib.math_utils.safe_divide cannot divide. Fix the consumer so zero denominators return the requested label.
tasks.test_context: The failing test covers both normal division and the custom label used when division is not possible.

tasks.title: Session keys should use provider cache formatting
tasks.problem_statement: consumer_app.cache_keys is bypassing providerlib.cache.build_cache_key. Fix the consumer so session keys include providerlib's normalization and version suffix.
tasks.test_context: The failing test expects lowercase normalization and the provider version suffix on session keys.

tasks.title: Badge colors should use provider mapping
tasks.problem_statement: consumer_app.statuses is returning raw status text instead of the providerlib.ui.status_to_color mapping. Fix the consumer so status badges use provider-defined colors.
tasks.test_context: The failing test expects queued and failed statuses to map to provider-defined badge colors.
